sourceSteps.title: Start with a garden
sourceSteps.task: Browse garden photos, layouts and grower profiles. The next stops follow one editable farm.
sourceSteps.secondaryLabel: Open the garden on the map

sourceSteps.title: Plan the growing season
sourceSteps.task: Start on Planting in Design Studio. Select a bed or tree, move it and try Undo. Then open the crop plan to compare vegetable beds, staple plots and planting months.

sourceSteps.title: Learn and find guidance
sourceSteps.task: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty and try a lesson, narrated slide or quiz. Then open Ask Lima, review the problem photo and tap its follow-up question.

sourceSteps.title: Record the work and the sale
sourceSteps.task: Compare harvests, sales and expenses in Charts. Open invoices, choose Saved and open an existing invoice to find Share PDF and Print. See how the farmer keeps a digital record; you do not need to send anything to a buyer.

sourceSteps.title: Support a group of growers
sourceSteps.task: Start in Fieldwork to review due actions and assigned gardens. Record a visit, check a practical skill and agree the next action. Use Training for attendance and feedback, Learning for modules, and Messages for follow-up.

sourceSteps.title: Follow the whole programme
sourceSteps.task: Open Training & progress, then Training register. Review the attendance signatures, certificates, venue map, photographs and short feedback survey. Open Reports to compare programme results.

sourceSteps.title: See progress as a funder
sourceSteps.task: Review Cohort totals and charts, then choose Progress & milestones. Compare recorded progress with targets and open the shared assessments or reports.

sourceSteps.title: Turn site evidence into a report
sourceSteps.task: Choose Download evidence report for a branded PDF with the assessment, visit notes, photos and soil results. Then explore Saved sites & reports: choose a site to see which photos, tests, survey answers and design work would improve its full report.

sourceSteps.title: Shape it for your programme
sourceSteps.task: Choose Request a feature to see how you can describe a change that would help your programme. Explore the form only: sending it contacts the real developer. Customisation scope and pricing are agreed together.

garden.title: Choose a garden
garden.text: Open a garden card to see its grower, photographs and growing areas. Use the map to explore where it is.

garden.title: Follow the same farm
garden.text: The next stops connect a garden design with its studies, harvests, sales and programme reports.

planning.title: See the ground beneath your plan
planning.text: The Base step holds the site image. In Glossy, use Underlay to switch between your photo, satellite and plain paper.

planning.title: Move something and try Undo
planning.text: Select a tree or bed and drag it. Undo restores the previous position. The Layers panel controls which items you can select and move.

planning.title: Place an entrance
planning.text: Choose a Gate in Structures. Drag its green move handle to position it; the gold end handle changes its length. The finished map shows the gate open and leaves an opening in the fence.

planning.title: Make a finished Design Map
planning.text: Open Glossy, choose a sheet and its underlay, then create a Design Map. Inspect the result full screen and use Export & Share for your selected sheets.

learning.title: Your studies start here
learning.text: Use Start studying or Continue learning to open your next module. Illustrated cards show the topics and your progress.

learning.title: Open an illustrated lesson
learning.text: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty to try a finished module. Choose a lesson picture or title to read, listen, watch slides and answer a quiz.

learning.title: Take the course home
learning.text: Open Study offline while you have signal. Choose the download quality and save the course or a single module to this phone.

business.title: Four pages in your farm book
business.text: Picked records harvests; Sold records sales; Spent holds costs; Charts brings the figures together. Switch tabs to follow the work from crop to cash.

business.title: Keep the paperwork together
business.text: Open Invoice, then Saved, to inspect a document. In Spent, open a receipt to see the purchase details behind a cost.

business.title: See a useful summary
business.text: In Picked, open Records for a lender to view harvest, income and cost history and export the summary.

mentor.title: Start with garden priorities
mentor.text: Fieldwork opens your due actions, participant coverage and food-security visit guide. Open People & gardens to start a visit with the participant already selected.

mentor.title: Follow learning and visits
mentor.text: Use Learning for module progress and Training for attendance, certificates and feedback. In a field visit, record the skill observed and the next action, owner and date.

organisation.title: See the programme together
organisation.text: Compare groups, gardens and recorded activity. Open Assessments to review the survey stages and responses.

organisation.title: Follow progress into reports
organisation.text: Training & progress brings training and project evidence together. Reports prepares the programme record for review and sharing.

funder.title: Look beyond attendance
funder.text: Explore cohort totals and charts, then Progress & milestones for the wider programme record.

funder.title: Inspect the evidence
funder.text: Open shared assessments and reports to see the records supporting the totals and the work still to be completed.

report.title: Start with a saved site
report.text: Saved sites & reports connects each site to its reports. Choose a site to create a report from its current information.

report.title: Make the next report stronger
report.text: Review the site checklist for photographs, soil and water tests, survey answers and design work. Download the evidence report to see the finished document.

next.title: Tell us what your programme needs
next.text: Choose Request a feature to describe the change and the app page. Download a copy of your draft, or sign in to send it to the developer.

sourceFarmTour.title: Find the garden
sourceFarmTour.task: Open the saved garden pin. Explore the map layers and garden boundary.

sourceFarmTour.title: Try the Design Studio
sourceFarmTour.task: Select a bed or tree, move it and try Undo.

sourceFarmTour.title: Review the site assessment
sourceFarmTour.task: Review the site assessment, change a water or site answer, then save.

sourceFarmTour.title: Explore the evidence pack
sourceFarmTour.task: Review the site pictures, soil results and household interview.

sourceFarmTour.title: Read the production plan
sourceFarmTour.task: Compare vegetable beds and staple plots. Inspect the planting calendar.

sourceFarmTour.title: Follow the harvest and money
sourceFarmTour.task: Compare harvests, income, costs and returns per square metre.

sourceFarmTour.title: Make a report
sourceFarmTour.task: Download the branded farm evidence report, including your saved edits and illustrative photos.

garden.title: Qala ngengadi
garden.task: Buka izithombe zengadi, izinhlelo zayo namaphrofayela abalimi. Izindawo ezilandelayo zilandela ipulazi elilodwa ongakwazi ukulihlela.

planning.title: Hlela isizini yokutshala
planning.task: Qala kokuthi Ukutshala ku-Design Studio. Khetha umbhede noma isihlahla, usisuse kwenye indawo bese uzama ukuhlehlisa. Bese uvula uhlelo lwezitshalo ukuze uqhathanise imibhede yemifino, iziza zezitshalo eziyisisekelo nezinyanga zokutshala.

learning.title: Funda futhi uthole isiqondiso
learning.task: Vula okuthi Imbewu Nobukhosi Bembewu, uzame isifundo, isilayidi esilandiswa ngezwi noma imibuzo. Bese uvula okuthi Buza uLima, ubuyekeze isithombe senkinga bese uthinta umbuzo wokulandelela.

business.title: Rekhoda umsebenzi nokuthengisa
business.task: Qhathanisa okuvunyiwe, ukuthengisa nezindleko kokuthi Amashadi. Vula ama-invoyisi, khetha Okulondoloziwe bese uvula i-invoyisi ekhona ukuze uthole okuthi Yabelana nge-PDF nokuthi Phrinta. Bona indlela umlimi agcina ngayo irekhodi ledijithali; awudingi ukuthumela lutho kumthengi.

mentor.title: Sekela iqembu labalimi
mentor.task: Qala kokuthi Umsebenzi wasensimini ukuze ubuyekeze imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe, izingadi owabelwe zona nabalimi. Rekhoda ukuvakashela, uhlole ikhono elisebenzayo bese nivumelana ngesinyathelo esilandelayo. Sebenzisa Ukuqeqesha ukuze urekhode ukuba khona nempendulo, Ukufunda ukuze ubuke amamojula, nemilayezo ukuze nilandelele.

organisation.title: Landela lonke uhlelo
organisation.task: Vula okuthi Ukuqeqeshwa nenqubekelaphambili, bese uvula irejista yokuqeqeshwa. Bheka amasiginesha okuba khona, izitifiketi, imephu yendawo, izithombe nohlu lwemibuzo olufushane lwempendulo. Vula Imibiko ukuze uqhathanise imiphumela yohlelo.

funder.title: Buka inqubekelaphambili njengomxhasi
funder.task: Bheka izibalo namashadi eqembu, bese ukhetha Inqubekelaphambili nezinyathelo ezibalulekile. Qhathanisa inqubekelaphambili erekhodiwe nemigomo, bese uvula ukuhlolwa noma imibiko eyabiwe.

report.title: Yenza umbiko ngobufakazi bendawo
report.task: Khetha okuthi Landa umbiko wobufakazi ukuze uthole i-PDF enophawu lohlelo, ukuhlolwa kwendawo, amanothi okuvakasha, izithombe nemiphumela yomhlabathi. Bese uhlola Amasayithi nemibiko egciniwe: khetha isayithi ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izithombe, izivivinyo, izimpendulo zohlolo nomsebenzi wokuklama okungathuthukisa umbiko walo ophelele.

next.title: Lungisela uhlelo lwakho
next.task: Khetha okuthi Cela isici ukuze ubone indlela yokuchaza ushintsho olungasiza uhlelo lwakho. Hlola ifomu kuphela: ukulithumela kuthinta umthuthukisi wangempela. Vumelanani ndawonye ngobubanzi bomsebenzi nezindleko zokwenza uhlelo lufaneleke.

garden.title: Khetha ingadi
garden.text: Vula ikhadi lengadi ukuze ubone umlimi wayo, izithombe nezindawo zokutshala. Sebenzisa imephu ukuze ubone ukuthi ikuphi.

garden.title: Landela ipulazi elifanayo
garden.text: Izindawo ezilandelayo zixhumanisa ukwakheka kwengadi nezifundo zayo, okuvunyiwe, ukuthengisa nemibiko yohlelo.

planning.title: Bona umhlaba ongaphansi kohlelo lwakho
planning.text: Isinyathelo esithi Isisekelo sigcina isithombe sesayithi. Kokuthi Glossy, sebenzisa okuthi Isendlalelo esingaphansi ukuze ushintshe phakathi kwesithombe sakho, isithombe sesathelayithi nephepha elingenalutho.

planning.title: Susa into kwenye indawo bese uhlehlisa
planning.text: Khetha isihlahla noma umbhede bese uwuhudula. Ukuhlehlisa kubuyisela indawo yawo yangaphambilini. Iphaneli ethi Izendlalelo ilawula ukuthi yiziphi izinto ongazikhetha uzisuse.

planning.title: Beka indawo yokungena
planning.text: Khetha Isango kokuthi Izakhiwo. Hudula isibambo salo esiluhlaza ukuze ulibeke; isibambo esisagolide esisekugcineni sishintsha ubude balo. Imephu ephelile ikhombisa isango livuliwe futhi lishiya indawo yokungena ocingweni.

planning.title: Yenza Imephu Yokuklama ephelile
planning.text: Vula i-Glossy, khetha ishidi nesendlalelo salo esingaphansi, bese wenza Imephu Yokuklama. Hlola umphumela esikrinini esigcwele bese usebenzisa okuthi Thumela futhi Yabelana kumashidi owakhethile.

learning.title: Izifundo zakho ziqala lapha
learning.text: Sebenzisa okuthi Qala ukufunda noma Qhubeka nokufunda ukuze uvule imojuli yakho elandelayo. Amakhadi anezithombe akhombisa izihloko nenqubekelaphambili yakho.

learning.title: Vula isifundo esinezithombe
learning.text: Vula okuthi Imbewu Nobukhosi Bembewu ukuze uzame imojuli ephelile. Khetha isithombe noma isihloko sesifundo ukuze ufunde, ulalele, ubuke izilayidi uphendule imibuzo.

learning.title: Hamba nesifundo ekhaya
learning.text: Vula okuthi Funda ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi usenophawu lwenethiwekhi. Khetha ikhwalithi yokulanda bese ugcina isifundo noma imojuli eyodwa kule foni.

business.title: Amakhasi amane ebhukwini lepulazi
business.text: Okukhethiwe kurekhoda isivuno; Okuthengisiwe kurekhoda ukuthengisa; Okusetshenzisiwe kugcina izindleko; Amashadi ahlanganisa izibalo. Shintsha amathebhu ukuze ulandele umsebenzi kusukela esitshalweni kuye emalini.

business.title: Gcina amaphepha ndawonye
business.text: Vula i-invoyisi, bese uvula Okulondoloziwe ukuze uhlole idokhumenti. Kokuthi Okusetshenzisiwe, vula irisidi ukuze ubone imininingwane yokuthenga ehambisana nezindleko.

business.title: Bona isifinyezo esiwusizo
business.text: Kokuthi Okukhethiwe, vula Imibiko yomabolekisi ukuze ubuke umlando wesivuno, wemali engenayo nowezindleko bese uthumela isifinyezo.

mentor.title: Qala ngezinto ezibalulekile engadini
mentor.text: Umsebenzi wasensimini uvula imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe, ukumbozwa kwabahlanganyeli nomhlahlandlela wokuvakasha wokuhlola ukutholakala kokudla. Vula Abantu nezingadi ukuze uqale ukuvakasha kukhethwe umhlanganyeli ofanele.

mentor.title: Landela ukufunda nokuvakasha
mentor.text: Sebenzisa Ukufunda ukuze ubuke inqubekelaphambili yamamojuli, nokuQeqesha ukuze ubuke ukuba khona, izitifiketi nempendulo. Ekuvakasheni kwasensimini, rekhoda ikhono olibone nesinyathelo esilandelayo, umuntu ozosenza nosuku.

organisation.title: Bona uhlelo lonke ndawonye
organisation.text: Qhathanisa amaqembu, izingadi nomsebenzi orekhodiwe. Vula Ukuhlolwa ukuze ubuyekeze izigaba zohlolo nezimpendulo.

organisation.title: Landela inqubekelaphambili iye emibikweni
organisation.text: Ukuqeqeshwa nenqubekelaphambili kuhlanganisa ubufakazi bokuqeqeshwa nobomsebenzi. Imibiko ilungiselela irekhodi lohlelo ukuze libuyekezwe futhi kwabelwane ngalo.

funder.title: Bheka okungaphezu kokuba khona
funder.text: Hlola izibalo namashadi eqembu, bese uvula Inqubekelaphambili nezinyathelo ezibalulekile ukuze ubone irekhodi lohlelo olubanzi.

funder.title: Hlola ubufakazi
funder.text: Vula ukuhlolwa nemibiko eyabiwe ukuze ubone amarekhodi asekelayo izibalo nomsebenzi okusamele wenziwe.

report.title: Qala ngesayithi eligciniwe
report.text: Amasayithi nemibiko egciniwe ixhumanisa isayithi ngalinye nemibiko yalo. Khetha isayithi ukuze wenze umbiko ngolwazi lwalo lwamanje.

report.title: Thuthukisa umbiko olandelayo
report.text: Bheka uhlu lwesayithi lwezithombe, izivivinyo zomhlabathi nezamanzi, izimpendulo zohlolo nomsebenzi wokuklama. Landa umbiko wobufakazi ukuze ubone idokhumenti ephelile.

next.title: Sitshele ukuthi uhlelo lwakho ludingani
next.text: Khetha okuthi Cela isici ukuze uchaze ushintsho nekhasi lohlelo oluthintekayo. Landa ikhophi yohlaka lwakho, noma ungene ngemvume ukuze uluthumele kumthuthukisi.

entries.english: Browse garden photos, layouts and grower profiles. The next stops follow one editable farm.
entries.st: Sheba ditshwantsho tsa dirapa, meralo ya tsona le diprofaele tsa balemi. Mehato e latelang e latela polasi e le nngwe eo o ka e fetolang.
entries.ts: Languta swifaniso swa swirhapa, mapulanelo ni tiphurofayili ta varimi. Switichi leswi landzelaka swi landzela purasi rin’we leri u nga ri hundzulaka.
entries.ve: Sedzani zwifanyiso zwa ngade, mivhekanyo yadzo na phurofaiḽi dza vhalimi. Zwititshi zwi tevhelaho zwi tevhela bulasi ḽithihi ḽine na nga ḽi shandula.

entries.english: Start on Planting in Design Studio. Select a bed or tree, move it and try Undo. Then open the crop plan to compare vegetable beds, staple plots and planting months.
entries.st: Qala ho Ho lema ho Design Studio. Kgetha bethe kapa sefate, se suthise mme o leke Kgutlisa. Ebe o bula moralo wa dijalo ho bapisa dibethe tsa meroho, masimo a dijalo tsa motheo le dikgwedi tsa ho lema.
entries.ts: Sungula eka Ku byala eka Design Studio. Hlawula mubedo kumbe murhi, wu susumete kutani u ringeta Tlherisela. Kutani pfula pulani ya swibyariwa ku pimanisa mibedo ya matsavu, masimu ya swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka ni tin’hweti to byala.
entries.ve: Thomani kha U zwala kha Design Studio. Nangani mubete kana muri, ni u sudzuluse ni lingedze Humisela murahu. Ni kone u vula pulane ya zwilimwa u vhambedza mibete ya miroho, masimu a zwilimwa zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme na miṅwedzi ya u zwala.

entries.ve: Vulani pulane ya vhubveledzi

entries.english: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty and try a lesson, narrated slide or quiz. Then open Ask Lima, review the problem photo and tap its follow-up question.
entries.st: Bula Seeds and Seed Sovereignty mme o leke thuto, selaete se nang le tlhaloso ya lentswe kapa dipotso. Ebe o bula Botsa Lima, o shebe setshwantsho sa bothata mme o tobetse potso e latelang.
entries.ts: Pfula Seeds and Seed Sovereignty kutani u ringeta dyondzo, xilayidi lexi hlamuseriwaka hi rito kumbe swivutiso. Kutani pfula Vutisa Lima, u languta xifaniso xa xiphiqo kutani u khumba xivutiso lexi landzelaka.
entries.ve: Vulani Seeds and Seed Sovereignty ni lingedze ngudo, siḽaidi i re na ṱhalutshedzo ya ipfi kana mbudziso. Ni kone u vula Vhudzisani Lima, ni sedze tshifanyiso tsha thaidzo ni kwame mbudziso i tevhelaho.

entries.english: Compare harvests, sales and expenses in Charts. Open invoices, choose Saved and open an existing invoice to find Share PDF and Print. See how the farmer keeps a digital record; you do not need to send anything to a buyer.
entries.st: Bapisa kotulo, thekiso le ditshenyehelo ho Dikerafo. Bula diinvoyese, kgetha Bolokilwe mme o bule invoyese e teng ho fumana Arolelana PDF le Printa. Bona kamoo molemi a bolokang rekoto ya dijithale; ha ho hlokahale hore o romele letho ho moreki.
entries.ts: Pimanisa ntshovelo, ku xavisa ni tihakelo eka Tichati. Pfula ti-invoyisi, hlawula Hlayisiwile kutani u pfula invoyisi leyi nga kona ku kuma Avelana PDF ni Printa. Vona ndlela leyi murimi a hlayisaka rhekhodo ya xidijitali ha yona; a swi bohi ku rhumela xanchumu eka muxavi.
entries.ve: Vhambedzani khaṋo, thengiso na mbadelo kha Zwitshati. Vulani invoisi, nangani Zwo vhulungwa ni vule invoisi i re hone u wana Kovhani PDF na Gandisani. Vhonani nḓila ine mulimi a vhulunga ngayo rekhodo ya didzhithala; a ni tei u rumela tshithu kha murengi.

entries.english: Start in Fieldwork to review due actions and assigned gardens. Record a visit, check a practical skill and agree the next action. Use Training for attendance and feedback, Learning for modules, and Messages for follow-up.
entries.st: Qala ho Mosebetsi wa masimong ho hlahloba mesebetsi e lokelang ho etswa le dirapa tseo o di abetsweng. Rekota ketelo, hlahloba bokgoni bo sebetsang mme le dumellane ka kgato e latelang. Sebelisa Thupelo bakeng sa boteng le maikutlo, Ho ithuta bakeng sa dimojule, le Melaetsa bakeng sa ho latella.
entries.ts: Sungula eka Ntirho wa le masin’wini ku kambela mintirho leyi faneleke ku endliwa ni swirhapa leswi u averiweke swona. Rekhoda riendzo, kambela vuswikoti bya ku tirha kutani mi twanana hi goza leri landzelaka. Tirhisa Ndzetelo eka ku va kona ni mavonelo, Ku dyondza eka mimojulu, ni Marungula ku landzelerisa.
entries.ve: Thomani kha Mushumo wa masimuni u ṱola mishumo ine ya tea u itwa na ngade dze na avhelwa. Rekhodani lwendo, ṱolani vhukoni ha nyito ni tendelane nga nyito i tevhelaho. Shumisani Vhugudisi kha u vha hone na mbuyedzedzo, U guda kha mimoḓulu, na Milaedza kha u tevhelela.

entries.ve: Tevhelani mbekanyamushumo yoṱhe

entries.english: Open Training & progress, then Training register. Review the attendance signatures, certificates, venue map, photographs and short feedback survey. Open Reports to compare programme results.
entries.st: Bula Thupelo le tswelopele, ebe o bula Rejisetara ya thupelo. Hlahloba ditshaeno tsa boteng, disetifikeiti, mmapa wa sebaka, ditshwantsho le dipatlisiso tse kgutshwane tsa maikutlo. Bula Ditlaleho ho bapisa diphetho tsa lenaneo.
entries.ts: Pfula Ndzetelo ni nhluvuko, kutani Rhejistara ya ndzetelo. Kambela tisayini ta ku va kona, switifikheti, mepe wa ndhawu, swifaniso ni swivutiso swo koma swa mavonelo. Pfula Swiviko ku pimanisa mbuyelo wa nongonoko.
entries.ve: Vulani Vhugudisi na mvelaphanḓa, ni kone u vula Redzhisitara ya vhugudisi. Ṱolani tsaino dza u vha hone, ṱhanziela, mapa wa fhethu, zwifanyiso na mbudziso pfufhi dza mbuyedzedzo. Vulani Mivhigo u vhambedza mvelelo dza mbekanyamushumo.

entries.st: Bona tswelopele jwaloka motshehetsi
entries.ts: Vona nhluvuko u ri museketeri wa mali
entries.ve: Vhonani mvelaphanḓa sa mulambedzi

entries.english: Review Cohort totals and charts, then choose Progress & milestones. Compare recorded progress with targets and open the shared assessments or reports.
entries.st: Hlahloba dipalo tsa sehlopha le dikerafo, ebe o kgetha Tswelopele le diketsahalo tsa bohlokwa. Bapisa tswelopele e rekotilweng le dipheo mme o bule ditekolo kapa ditlaleho tse arolelanweng.
entries.ts: Kambela tinhlayo ta ntlawa ni tichati, kutani u hlawula Nhluvuko ni magoza ya nkoka. Pimanisa nhluvuko lowu rekhodiweke ni swikongomelo kutani u pfula mikambelo kumbe swiviko leswi avelaniweke.
entries.ve: Ṱolani mbalo dza tshigwada na zwitshati, ni kone u nanga Mvelaphanḓa na zwiga zwa ndeme. Vhambedzani mvelaphanḓa yo rekhodiwaho na zwipikwa ni vule ṱhaṱhuvho kana mivhigo yo kovhiwaho.

entries.english: Turn site evidence into a report
entries.st: Fetola bopaki ba sebaka hore e be tlaleho
entries.ts: Endla xiviko hi vumbhoni bya ndhawu
entries.ve: Shandulani vhuṱanzi ha fhethu vhu vhe muvhigo

entries.english: Choose Download evidence report for a branded PDF with the assessment, visit notes, photos and soil results. Then explore Saved sites & reports: choose a site to see which photos, tests, survey answers and design work would improve its full report.
entries.st: Kgetha Kopitsa tlaleho ya bopaki bakeng sa PDF e nang le letshwao la lenaneo, tekolo, dintlha tsa ketelo, ditshwantsho le diphetho tsa mobu. Ebe o lekola Dibaka le ditlaleho tse bolokilweng: kgetha sebaka ho bona hore na ke ditshwantsho, diteko, dikarabo tsa dipatlisiso le mosebetsi ofe wa ho rala tse ka ntlafatsang tlaleho ya sona e felletseng.
entries.ts: Hlawula Kopa xiviko xa vumbhoni leswaku u kuma PDF leyi nga ni mfungho wa nongonoko, nkambelo, tinotsi ta riendzo, swifaniso ni mbuyelo wa misava. Kutani kambela Tindhawu ni swiviko leswi hlayisiweke: hlawula ndhawu ku vona leswaku hi swihi swifaniso, swikambelo, tinhlamulo ta swivutiso ni mintirho yo dizayina leswi nga antswisaka xiviko xa yona lexi heleleke.
entries.ve: Nangani Kopololani muvhigo wa vhuṱanzi u wana PDF i re na luswayo lwa mbekanyamushumo, ṱhaṱhuvho, notsi dza lwendo, zwifanyiso na mvelelo dza mavu. Ni kone u ṱola Fhethu na mivhigo zwo vhulungwaho: nangani fhethu u vhona uri ndi zwifanyiso zwifhio, milingo, phindulo dza mbudziso na mushumo wa u pulana zwine zwa nga khwinisa muvhigo waho wo fhelelaho.

entries.english: Choose Request a feature to see how you can describe a change that would help your programme. Explore the form only: sending it contacts the real developer. Customisation scope and pricing are agreed together.
entries.st: Kgetha Kopa tshebetso ho bona kamoo o ka hlalosang phetoho e ka thusang lenaneo la hao. Lekola foromo feela: ho e romela ho ikopanya le moetsi wa app wa nnete. Boholo ba mosebetsi wa ho e fetola le ditheko di dumellanwa mmoho.
entries.ts: Hlawula Kombela xitirhisiwa ku vona ndlela yo hlamusela ku cinca loku nga pfunaka nongonoko wa wena. Kambela fomo ntsena: ku yi rhumela swi tihlanganisa ni muendli wa app wa xiviri. Vukulu bya ku cinca loku lavekaka ni minxavo swi twananiwa swin’we.
entries.ve: Nangani Humbelani tshumelo u vhona nḓila ya u ṱalutshedza tshanduko ine ya nga thusa mbekanyamushumo yaṋu. Ṱolani fomo fhedzi: u i rumela zwi kwama muḓivhi wa app wa vhukuma. Vhuhulu ha mushumo wa u shandula na mitengo zwi tendelanwa zwoṱhe.

entries.st: Bula karete ya serapa ho bona molemi wa sona, ditshwantsho le dibaka tsa ho lema. Sebelisa mmapa ho lekola moo se leng teng.
entries.ts: Pfula khadi ra xirhapa leswaku u vona murimi wa xona, swifaniso ni tindhawu to byala. Tirhisa mepe ku kambela laha xi nga kona.
entries.ve: Vulani garaṱa ya ngade u vhona mulimi wayo, zwifanyiso na fhethu ha u zwala. Shumisani mapa u ṱola hune ya vha hone.

entries.st: Mehato e latelang e hokahanya moralo wa serapa le dithuto tsa sona, kotulo, thekiso le ditlaleho tsa lenaneo.
entries.ts: Switichi leswi landzelaka swi hlanganisa dizayini ya xirhapa ni tidyondzo ta xona, ntshovelo, ku xavisa ni swiviko swa nongonoko.
entries.ve: Zwititshi zwi tevhelaho zwi ṱumanya pulane ya ngade na ngudo dzayo, khaṋo, thengiso na mivhigo ya mbekanyamushumo.

entries.st: Mohato wa Motheo o na le setshwantsho sa sebaka. Ho Glossy, sebelisa Lera le ka tlase ho fapanyetsana pakeng tsa setshwantsho sa hao, sa sathelaete le pampiri e sa ngolwang.
entries.ts: Goza ra Masungulo ri ni xifaniso xa ndhawu. Eka Glossy, tirhisa Leyara ya le hansi ku cinca phakathi ka xifaniso xa wena, xa sathelayiti ni phepha leri nga tsariwangiki.
entries.ve: Nyito ya Mutheo i na tshifanyiso tsha fhethu. Kha Glossy, shumisani Leyara ya fhasi u shandula vhukati ha tshifanyiso tshaṋu, tsha sathaḽaithi na bammbiri ḽi si na tshithu.

entries.english: Select a tree or bed and drag it. Undo restores the previous position. The Layers panel controls which items you can select and move.
entries.st: Kgetha sefate kapa bethe mme o e hule. Kgutlisa e e busetsa boemong ba pele. Phanele ya Mera e laola dintho tseo o ka di kgethang le ho di suthisa.
entries.ts: Hlawula murhi kumbe mubedo kutani u wu koka. Tlherisela swi tlherisela ndhawu ya le ku sunguleni. Phanele ya Tileya yi lawula leswi u nga swi hlawulaka ni ku swi susumeta.
entries.ve: Nangani muri kana mubete ni u kokodze. Humisela murahu zwi humisela fhethu ha u thoma. Phanele ya Leyara i langa zwithu zwine na nga zwi nanga na u zwi sudzulusa.

entries.ve: Vheani fhethu ha u dzhena

entries.english: Choose a Gate in Structures. Drag its green move handle to position it; the gold end handle changes its length. The finished map shows the gate open and leaves an opening in the fence.
entries.st: Kgetha Heke ho Mehaho. Hula motshwari wa yona o motala ho e beha; motshwari wa kgauta o qetellong o fetola bolelele ba yona. Mmapa o felileng o bontsha heke e butswe mme o siya sekgeo terateng.
entries.ts: Hlawula Gede eka Miako. Koka xikhomo xa yona xa rihlaza leswaku u yi veka; xikhomo xa nsuku emakumu xi cinca ku leha ka yona. Mepe lowu heleleke wu komba gede yi pfulekile naswona wu siya xivandla erihlampfungwini.
entries.ve: Nangani Gethe kha Zwifhaṱo. Kokodzani tshifaro tshayo tsha mudala u i vhea; tshifaro tsha musuku tsha magumoni tshi shandula vhulapfu hayo. Mapa wo fhelelaho u sumbedza gethe yo vulea na u sia tshikhala kha luhura.

entries.ve: Itani Mapa wa Pulane wo fhelelaho

entries.english: Open Glossy, choose a sheet and its underlay, then create a Design Map. Inspect the result full screen and use Export & Share for your selected sheets.
entries.st: Bula Glossy, kgetha leqephe le lera la lona le ka tlase, ebe o etsa Mmapa wa Moralo. Hlahloba sephetho sekirining se felletseng mme o sebedise Romela le Arolelana bakeng sa maqephe ao o a kgethileng.
entries.ts: Pfula Glossy, hlawula pheji ni leyara ya yona ya le hansi, kutani u endla Mepe wa Dizayini. Kambela mbuyelo eka xikirini hinkwaxo kutani u tirhisa Humesa ni Avelana eka mapheji lawa u ma hlawuleke.
entries.ve: Vulani Glossy, nangani siaṱari na leyara yaḽo ya fhasi, ni kone u ita Mapa wa Pulane. Ṱolani mvelelo kha tshikirini tshoṱhe ni shumise Rumelani na Kovhani kha masiaṱari e na nanga.

entries.ts: Tidyondzo ta wena ti sungula laha

entries.english: Use Start studying or Continue learning to open your next module. Illustrated cards show the topics and your progress.
entries.st: Sebelisa Qala ho ithuta kapa Tswela pele ho ithuta ho bula mojule wa hao o latelang. Dikarete tse nang le ditshwantsho di bontsha dihlooho le tswelopele ya hao.
entries.ts: Tirhisa Sungula ku dyondza kumbe Yana mahlweni u dyondza ku pfula mojulu wa wena lowu landzelaka. Makhadi ya swifaniso ma komba tinhlokomhaka ni nhluvuko wa wena.
entries.ve: Shumisani Thomani u guda kana Bvelani phanḓa ni tshi guda u vula moḓulu waṋu u tevhelaho. Garaṱa dza zwifanyiso dzi sumbedza ṱhoho na mvelaphanḓa yaṋu.

entries.ts: Pfula dyondzo ya swifaniso
entries.ve: Vulani ngudo i re na zwifanyiso

entries.english: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty to try a finished module. Choose a lesson picture or title to read, listen, watch slides and answer a quiz.
entries.st: Bula Seeds and Seed Sovereignty ho leka mojule o felileng. Kgetha setshwantsho kapa sehlooho sa thuto ho bala, ho mamela, ho sheba diselaete le ho araba dipotso.
entries.ts: Pfula Seeds and Seed Sovereignty leswaku u ringeta mojulu lowu heleleke. Hlawula xifaniso kumbe nhlokomhaka ya dyondzo leswaku u hlaya, u yingisela, u hlalela swilayidi ni ku hlamula swivutiso.
entries.ve: Vulani Seeds and Seed Sovereignty u lingedza moḓulu wo fhelelaho. Nangani tshifanyiso kana ṱhoho ya ngudo u vhala, u thetshelesa, u sedza siḽaidi na u fhindula mbudziso.

entries.english: Open Study offline while you have signal. Choose the download quality and save the course or a single module to this phone.
entries.st: Bula Ithute ntle le inthanete ha o sa na le kgokahano. Kgetha boleng ba ho kopitsa mme o boloke thupelo kapa mojule o le mong fonong ena.
entries.ts: Pfula Dyondza handle ka inthanete loko wa ha ri ni vuhlanganisi. Hlawula khwalithi yo kopa kutani u hlayisa khoso kumbe mojulu wun’we eka riqingho leri.
entries.ve: Vulani Gudani ni si na inthanethe musi ni tshe na vhuṱumani. Nangani vhuvha ha u kopolola ni vhulunge khoso kana moḓulu muthihi kha founu iyi.

entries.english: Picked records harvests; Sold records sales; Spent holds costs; Charts brings the figures together. Switch tabs to follow the work from crop to cash.
entries.st: Kotutswe e rekota kotulo; Rekisitswe e rekota thekiso; Sebediswe e boloka ditshenyehelo; Dikerafo e kopanya dipalo. Fetola dithepo ho latela mosebetsi ho tloha sejalong ho ya tjheleteng.
entries.ts: Ntshovelo swi rekhoda ntshovelo; Ku xavisa swi rekhoda ku xavisa; Tihakelo swi hlayisa tihakelo; Tichati ti hlanganisa tinhlayo. Cinca tithebhu ku landzela umsebenzi ku suka eka xibyariwa ku ya eka mali.
entries.ve: Khaṋo i rekhoda khaṋo; Thengiso i rekhoda thengiso; Mbadelo i vhulunga mbadelo; Zwitshati dzi ṱanganya mbalo. Shandulani thebu u tevhela mushumo u bva kha tshilimwa u ya kha mali.

entries.english: Ubhejane is currently the connected editable farm. The 18 garden profiles above are overview examples. Try the map and editable design, review a completed assessment, review the household interview and soil record, then download an evidence report.
entries.st: Ubhejane ke polasi e hokahaneng e ka fetolwang ha jwale. Diprofaele tsa dirapa tse 18 tse ka hodimo ke mehlala ya kakaretso. Leka mmapa le moralo o ka fetolwang, hlahloba tekolo e phethilweng, puisano ya lelapa le rekoto ya mobu, ebe o kopitsa tlaleho ya bopaki.
entries.ts: Sweswi Ubhejane i purasi leri hlanganisiweke leri nga hundzuluxiwaka. Tiphurofayili ta swirhapa swa 18 laha henhla i swikombiso swa nkatsakanyo. Ringeta mepe ni dizayini leyi nga hundzuluxiwaka, kambela nkambelo lowu heleke, mbulavurisano wa muti ni rhekhodo ya misava, kutani u kopa xiviko xa vumbhoni.
entries.ve: Zwino Ubhejane ndi bulasi ḽo ṱumanaho ḽine ḽa nga shandulwa. Phurofaiḽi dza ngade dza 18 dzi re afho nṱha ndi tsumbo dza manweledzo. Lingedzani mapa na pulane ine ya nga shandulwa, ṱolani ṱhaṱhuvho yo fhedzwaho, nyambedzano ya muṱa na rekhodo ya mavu, ni kone u kopolola muvhigo wa vhuṱanzi.

entries.english: A fictional warm KZN farm with vegetables, staples, fruit, nuts, berries, eggs, milk, honey and fish. View its monthly calendar, young trees and printable plan. Shown in English.
entries.st: Polasi e iqapetsweng e sebakeng se futhumetseng sa KZN e nang le meroho, dijalo tsa motheo, ditholwana, “nuts”, monokotsoai, mahe, lebese, mahe a dinotshi le ditlhapi. Sheba khalendara ya yona ya kgwedi le kgwedi, difate tse nyane le moralo o ka printwang. E bontshwa ka Senyesemane.
entries.ts: Purasi ro ehleketeleriwa ra KZN leyi kufumelaka leri nga ni matsavu, swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka, mihandzu, “nuts”, “berries”, matandza, masi, vulombe ni tinhlampfi. Languta khalendara ya rona ya n’hweti ni n’hweti, mirhi leyitsongo ni pulani leyi nga printiwaka. Swi kombiwa hi Xinghezi.
entries.ve: Bulasi ḽa khumbulelo kha fhethu hu dudelaho ha KZN ḽi re na miroho, zwilimwa zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme, mitshelo, “nuts”, mitshelo miṱuku ya maberi, makumba, mafhi, mutoli na khovhe. Sedzani khalanḓara yaḽo ya ṅwedzi muṅwe na muṅwe, miri miṱuku na pulane ine ya nga gandiswa. Zwi sumbedzwa nga English.

entries.ve: Tshanduko dzi sala kha sesheni iyi ya lwendo. U vusuludza kana u laisa hafhu zwi thoma hafhu. A zwi ṱoḓi uri ni dzhene nahone u shandula mbonalo a zwi shanduli thendelo dza akhaunthu yaṋu ya vhukuma.
